verdict.rationale: Filee is described as a free, open-source (MIT) file converter, so developers can run real conversions at no cost through the app or the documented CLI (`filee convert ... --to`, with `--json` output). The public GitHub repo can also be built from source, so there is no paywall to clear before testing. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the free version has no feature or volume limits, and independent corroboration of the free/no-paid-tier status beyond the llms.txt probe.
